typedef void(*) BtWriteCompletionFn_t(BtConn_t conn, BtErr_t err)

Write completion routine. Called when a packet submitted via HxBtWrite has been completed by the profile/protocol handler.

If Write returns a failure, then the completion routine will not be called. If the Write routine returns success or pending, the completion routine will be called. In the case of pending, the completion routine may be called at a later time.

Parameters:
conn IN connection handle for profile
err IN Error code for write
